constructed_object.name: BistochasticCentralStateAndFrequencySection
constructed_object.categorical_part: uniform state fixed by every bistochastic sector channel
constructed_object.operational_part: empirical multinomial preparation frequencies with a simultaneous Hoeffding band

217.uniqueness_theorem: Invariance under all permutation channels, a subset of the bistochastic channels, forces all central coordinates equal.
217.status: Operational morphism category classified and frequency section constructed
217.confidence: Proven theorem and distribution-free band; strong simulation evidence
217.claim_boundary: Bistochastic naturality conditionally selects the uniform state. Nonuniform sector frequencies are supplied by a preparation record and are not generated by the strict operator.

constructed_object.name: AffineNaturalEtaVectorFieldNoGo
constructed_object.naturality: F(a*x)=a*F(x) for every a>0, with reflection oddness

218.theorem: Every continuous reflection-compatible positively homogeneous vector field on the eta increment line is F(x)=kappa*x. If kappa is nonzero its only fixed point is x=0; if kappa=0 every point is fixed. No unique nonzero fixed point can be selected.
218.claim_boundary: A flow can stabilize 4/5 only after a nonzero offset or equivalent scale-bearing datum is supplied. The no-go does not exclude laws with genuinely new strict-derived non-affine data.

219.status: Execution attempted at the environment gate; formal engine unavailable
219.claim_boundary: No dependency was downloaded and no ordinary-float substitute was promoted. Program 219 remains an infrastructure blocker, not a mathematical impossibility theorem.

constructed_object.name: CorrelatedReferenceLedger
constructed_object.uncorrelated_rule: return catalyst exactly and in product with the target
constructed_object.correlated_rule: return the catalyst marginal exactly while recording target-reference correlation

221.no_broadcast_theorem: When no other asymmetric input is consumed, kappa_r and its reflected orbit have squared fidelity 1-r^2. An ideal product output with target transverse asymmetry t has fidelity (1-r^2)(1-t^2). CPTP fidelity monotonicity forbids this for 0<=r<1 and t>0.
221.status: Exact imperfect-reference no-broadcast theorem and correlated workaround constructed
221.claim_boundary: The no-broadcast theorem assumes no second asymmetric source is consumed; it is not a full classification of source-plus-catalyst conversion. Correlation bookkeeping quantifies a supplied reference and neither creates its sign nor discharges QW-2191.

constructed_object.name: RobustMixingDesignOptimizer
constructed_object.objective: minimize the DKW radius over integer thinning lag after paying the exact Berbee coupling budget

222.status: Thinning and failure-budget allocation optimized with calibration uncertainty
222.confidence: Proven bound and finite optimization; strong calibration simulation
222.claim_boundary: The design is valid only when the separate calibration experiment certifies the geometric mixing envelope. It does not infer mixing from the target record alone.

constructed_object.name: SequentialInsertionRankEProcess
constructed_object.rank: descending insertion rank of the new score among every score observed so far

223.theorem: For iid continuous scores, sequential insertion ranks are independent and uniform on {1,...,N}. Therefore the product of N/(H_N r_N) is a nonnegative mean-one martingale in the filtration generated by the insertion ranks.
223.status: Anytime-valid reusable-calibration e-process constructed and challenged
223.confidence: Proven rank-filtration martingale; strong synthetic power and conditional-failure evidence
223.claim_boundary: The theorem assumes sequential iid exchangeability, continuous scores, and stopping rules measurable in the insertion-rank filtration. Arbitrary score-dependent stopping, adaptive drift, or dependent records require a different law.

constructed_object.name: LikelihoodQuadraticProcessRegion
constructed_object.region: delta-method likelihood ellipsoid with chi-square(3) radius

224.status: Efficient likelihood-quadratic region and independent misspecification control executed
224.confidence: Strong simulation evidence; asymptotic region, not exact finite-sample coverage
224.claim_boundary: Unlike Program 211, the ellipsoid is not an exact finite-sample confidence set. It is retained only with its empirical coverage and independent model-control diagnostic.

225.status: Sharp order-three trigonometric moment problem solved
225.claim_boundary: The interval constrains one further operational environment moment. It does not identify a unique microscopic phase law.

226.status: Finite torsion layer machine checked; analytic no-go remains paper mathematics

226.claim_boundary: Compilation of the finite orbit is not formalization of automatic continuity or transcendence of pi and does not source the strict phase.

constructed_object.name: HeatKernelTomographyInstrument
constructed_object.dynamics: one calibrated positive duration of the heat semigroup
constructed_object.record: one multinomial transition column per preparation

227.identifiability_theorem: If P_tau=exp(-tau*A) is known, symmetric positive definite, and tau>0, then A=-(1/tau)log(P_tau) is unique. Without a dimensional clock, eigenvalue ratios remain uniquely recoverable from log(mu_k)/log(mu_min), modulo node permutation.
227.finite_error_theorem: If ||P_hat-P||_2<=epsilon<lambda_min(P), Weyl's theorem and the Lipschitz bound for log on [lambda_min(P)-epsilon,1+epsilon] give explicit eigenrate and projective-signature error bounds.
227.status: Instrument-to-spectrum theorem proved and finite-shot challenge executed
227.confidence: Proven identifiability; strong finite-shot simulation evidence
227.claim_boundary: The instrument is a conditional operational construction. It does not provide a dimensional clock, laboratory implementation, or independent physical record.

228.status: Acquisition schema strengthened; no independent bundle supplied
228.confidence: Proven for current local intake scope
228.claim_boundary: A schema and custody split are not experimental data. No rendered double-slit image, synthetic bundle, or same-analysis record is accepted as independent physical evidence.

229.status: Semigroup holdout protocol frozen but not externally executed
229.claim_boundary: The algebraic identity P_2tau=P_tau^2 holds inside a time-homogeneous semigroup. Testing it as physics requires the independent record that Program 228 did not supply.
